FX-DISTGRAD-001.says: The settings as they start: #6450a0, width 10, opacity 50, invert off, multiply. Every pixel that shows is darkened toward violet, the most along the block's edge, the dot and the quarter-covered column, and less at each pixel further in, and the least at (7, 5), sqrt 10 from the hole, the furthest from any out pixel; the empty pixels stay empty.

FX-DISTGRAD-002.says: Width 2, opacity 100, normal: the violet at full strength on the quarter-covered column, fading in over two pixels; column 0, on the drawing's left edge, is three quarters violet, as the top and bottom rows are; the pixels round the hole are shaded; and every pixel 2.5 or more from the nearest out pixel is left as it is: (7, 3) to (8, 6) in the shadow, and (2, 6) and (6, 6).

FX-DISTGRAD-003.says: Width 1, opacity 100, normal: a pixel beside an out pixel is half violet, one out on a diagonal only is shaded by 1 - (sqrt 2 - 0.5), about 0.086, and every pixel two or more from the edge is untouched.

FX-DISTGRAD-004.says: Width 0.5, opacity 100, normal: only the pixels that are themselves out and show, the quarter-covered column, are shaded, wholly violet at their own covering; every pixel that is in is untouched.

FX-DISTGRAD-006.says: Width 0 with invert on: still the drawing, untouched; width 0 comes first.

FX-DISTGRAD-008.says: Width 2, opacity 100, normal, invert on: FX-DISTGRAD-002 turned round, the quarter-covered column untouched, (7, 3) to (8, 6) wholly violet, and each pixel shaded by one less FX-DISTGRAD-002's strength.

FX-DISTGRAD-009.says: Invert on, the rest as they start: the middle darkened the most and the edge the least; the quarter-covered column is untouched.

FX-DISTGRAD-010.says: Blend normal, opacity 50: the violet laid over, at half the strength at most.

FX-DISTGRAD-011.says: Blend screen: every pixel that shows is lightened toward violet and none darkened; no channel passes the pixel's covering.

FX-DISTGRAD-012.says: Blend add: the violet added, past what a screen gives, the most at the edge.

FX-DISTGRAD-013.says: Colour #ffffff, multiply: multiplying by white changes nothing, and the drawing is untouched.

FX-DISTGRAD-014.says: FX-DISTGRAD-001 with the colour written in capitals, #6450A0: the same.

FX-DISTGRAD-015.says: Width keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 4 at frame 4, linear, opacity 100, normal: frame 0 is the drawing, frame 2 is width 2, FX-DISTGRAD-002, and frame 4 width 4; the shading reaches further in as the width grows.

FX-DISTGRAD-016.says: Opacity eased from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots, width 2, normal: at frame 2 it would pass 100, is held at 100, and is FX-DISTGRAD-002; frame 0 is the drawing.

FX-DISTGRAD-017.says: FX-DISTGRAD-001 moved three pixels right: the same, moved; the shading is worked on the drawing before it moves, so the drawing's left edge stays an edge.

FX-DISTGRAD-018.says: Width 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DISTGRAD-019.says: Width -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DISTGRAD-020.says: Opacity 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DISTGRAD-021.says: Opacity keyed to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DISTGRAD-022.says: Invert "yes", which is not "off" or "on". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DISTGRAD-023.says: Blend "overlay", which is not a blend. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DISTGRAD-024.says: Colour "#12345", one digit short. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
